Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 16, 2022

On Jun 15, 2022, TikTok ecom content/social platform builder Sanmo Tech (三墨科技) (founded Dec 2020; iPANDA) closed a multi-¥100k angel led by Zhejiang Xingzao — for iPANDA R&D, talent, and TikTok overseas ecom layout. Connects overseas creators with China CBEC brands/supply; short video, live, warehouse, marketing tasks, data. Controller Wang Xiaotong 64.44%.

— END —
